S05.title: The Road to Hveragerði, Day 3. The Red Band

paragraphs.S05.C000.P000: On the third morning, they left the Reykjavík guesthouse with their luggage: the next two nights were booked in Hveragerði. A red warning band appeared on Eric's phone over breakfast. He read the message twice and set the screen down beside his plate.
paragraphs.S05.C000.P001: “We're cancelling the long climb. The gusts will strengthen by noon.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P002: Nick, who had been spreading jam on bread, froze.
paragraphs.S05.C000.P006: “We could. And we could meet the wind in an exposed stretch earlier.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P008: “Dangerous enough that I'm not taking the group up there.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P009: Nick put down the knife. The usual performance disappeared from his face.
paragraphs.S05.C000.P010: “I get it. I just needed that shot.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P012: “You say that as if shots grow along the roadside.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P014: Alice expected the argument to continue, but Nick exhaled and asked:
paragraphs.S05.C000.P016: Eric unfolded the map. Today: a short valley and a geothermal trail, then check-in at Hveragerði. Tomorrow, if the rain did not stop, a greenhouse instead of an open-air walk. On the fifth day, the southern road to Skógafoss.
paragraphs.S05.C000.P017: “It's safer there. I won't promise anything beautiful.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P018: “Excellent,” Alice said. “Beautiful things usually get in the way of looking.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P020: “Is that a line for the article?”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P021: “No. I can steal from old men too.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P022: Damir brought the thermoses from the kitchen.
paragraphs.S05.C000.P025: He heard the old barb, but answered without defending himself:
paragraphs.S05.C000.P026: “Not always. I just try to check before I speak now.”
paragraphs.S05.C000.P027: Nick was quiet for twenty minutes in the car. Then he asked them to stop beside a small field where the wind drove waves through the grass. It was safe to film from the road. He set the camera low and caught not the mountain, but four pairs of boots passing by.

paragraphs.S05.C002.P000: “If the landscape doesn't work today, film us changing clothes in the rain,” Alice said. “Hands, wet jackets, the car door. No faces if anyone doesn't want them in it.”
paragraphs.S05.C002.P001: Nick looked at the gray strip of sky, then at his soaked sleeves.
paragraphs.S05.C002.P002: “I'll film myself first. If it turns out funny, I'll talk the others into it.”
paragraphs.S05.C002.P003: He took out the camera case; Alice held the door while he put the camera away from the rain. The argument about the lost view ended on its own.

S05.C003.title: B. Ask Eric to explain the change (`weatherChoice=erik`)

paragraphs.S05.C003.P000: “Eric, tell us exactly what's cancelled. I've already mixed up two turns and one waterfall.”
paragraphs.S05.C003.P001: He showed her the stretch of trail and the wind direction on his phone. They would skip the exposed climb; the short sheltered path was still possible if the rain eased. When Nick asked whether he was sure, Eric answered:
paragraphs.S05.C003.P002: “No. We'll decide at the trailhead. If it's the same there, we turn back.”
paragraphs.S05.C003.P003: Alice stopped building the failed day in her head: at least now it had two clear versions.

paragraphs.S05.C004.P000: Alice moved to the empty window seat. Damir shifted his backpack to the floor, making room for her.
paragraphs.S05.C004.P001: “You don't want to argue with the forecast either?” he asked.
paragraphs.S05.C004.P002: “I've had enough wind for one morning.”
paragraphs.S05.C004.P003: For a while they watched the rain blur the window. Damir did not offer her coffee, conversation, or one of their old familiar jokes. When the car stopped, he only asked whether she wanted her jacket from the back seat. Alice took it herself; he held the door against the wind.

paragraphs.S05.C005.P000: Before the short trail, they stopped at a small bakery. Because of the changed plan, it was the only place nearby that was open, and half the people the wind had driven off the routes had already gathered inside.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P001: There was one table for four and a chair by the window. Nick put the camera on the chair and stayed standing.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P003: “But it's more expensive than I am.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P004: Alice took the camera off the chair and set it beside her bag.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P009: Eric returned with their order number and four glasses of water.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P010: “The buns will be ready in ten minutes.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P013: “That's a violation of the group's democratic principles.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P014: “You bought beets and chocolate milk the day before yesterday.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P015: “The people made mistakes, but that's no reason to cancel the elections.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P017: “There are four different ones. You'll choose in order.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P021: “Because I know which one no one will take.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P022: The plate arrived: cinnamon, cardamom, chocolate, and a strange green icing.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P025: Nick immediately took the green one.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P026: “I won't let you defeat the system.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P028: “That's what people who win quietly say.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P029: Alice chose cardamom. Damir chose cinnamon. Eric was left with chocolate.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P034: “And you placed it so no one would take it first.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P039: She reached over and broke off a small edge of his bun.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P041: Eric looked at her fingers, then at the missing piece.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P044: He broke off a piece of her cardamom bun.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P046: Nick watched them over the green icing.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P047: “I wanted to say something witty, but the seaweed has taken away my future.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P048: Damir pushed the water toward him.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P049: “Don't rush it. It may be temporary.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P050: At the next table, a child dropped a mitten—blue, not red. Nick looked at Alice. She had noticed it too.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P052: “We definitely won't take the second mitten with us,” Nick said.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P053: “The child has already picked this one up,” Alice replied.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P055: “And the red one was left by the lake?”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P056: “On the post by the entrance,” Alice answered. “I hope its owner came back for it.”
paragraphs.S05.C005.P057: The waitress called out their order number for the bread to go. Eric got up to the counter; the others finished their water at the table. Nick looked at Alice as if he wanted to ask about Damir, but asked instead whether there would be enough buns for everyone.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P058: “If you don't eat two on the way,” she said.
paragraphs.S05.C005.P059: When Eric brought the bag, they put on their jackets and went out to the car. Damir held the door for Alice; she went through first without trying to interpret the gesture.
